title: Saronic feature film
description: A calm feature section: mono caption, big light title, a large 450-weight lead on the left half and a lime button at the right edge, over a full-width 16:9 video frame with an 8px radius. On the pale paper or on a slate band; 160px of air above and below on desktop.
notes: tone dark puts the section in a `dark` scope (slate band)
media is the 16:9 frame; empty it is a placeholder
